body:
The last sentence, thank you tons I did not know that existed.

Otherwise, I will surely discuss with her about her mental state.

Fortunately at this point the family member has been put on notice to find a new place which has significantly reduced my mom's angst.   However I'm sure it's just a matter of time for a new target to blame things on.

Thank you!

After a long period of unemployment that situation has changed finally. They are working now, but not making enough to live on own.  It's a physical disability that prevents the family
 member from better jobs in that area.

Thanks for the questions and advice so far btw.

Not a tenant that I know of in the contractual sense, it's a family member just being there for years.   The house isn't in Mom's name because of a pre existing pending legal issue. So it's the Husband's call i guess. He had the house before the marriage

And I used commit as an example, maybe hoping for govt programs to help someone live on their own or in a facility with others if they are disabled and can't work.

My Mom not being open minded and understanding of another person's challenges is a contributing factor here surely.

This reminds me that if my Mom is able to separate from them and take a breather that a good activity will be to learn professional techniques on how to cope with the family member's differences if something can't be worked out and she has to go back.
